title: Transit Allowed for a Vehicle in and out of the Workshop
content:
A vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that has been in and out of a workshop under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan is allowed transit miles against the booked stretch, and what is counted is the completed visits in the rolling three months counted back from the handling date.

- A vehicle with two or more completed Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan visits in that window is allowed 120 miles of workshop transit against the booked stretch.
- A vehicle with exactly one completed care plan visit in that window is allowed 60 miles.
- A vehicle with no completed care plan visit in that window is allowed none on this ground, an allowance of 0 miles.

*The window is a quarter.* The rolling three months are counted back from the handling date, so a completed visit dated four months back is not counted, however many such visits stand on the plan.

*Where the count divides.* At 2 completed visits inside the window the first clause governs; at exactly 1 the second; at none the third.
